title: 蜂医的复仇 EP01 · 重写示例
synopsis: 蜂医独自跑刀进大坝设施，撬开一个大保险柜，刚看到红色稀有物品，威龙推门进来，当面拿走。

characters.name: 蜂医
characters.identity_phrase: a man in his early thirties with short blond hair, a trimmed blond beard, blue eyes, a black over-ear headset with a boom mic, an olive-green plate carrier with a white medical cross patch over a grey long-sleeve shirt, dark-green cargo trousers and green-and-black tactical gloves
characters.voice_phrase: a man in his early thirties with a bright, slightly nasal voice and a quick, cocky pace

characters.name: 威龙
characters.identity_phrase: a tall man in a tan ballistic helmet with a dark tinted visor covering the eyes, a tan plate carrier over a grey-blue combat shirt, tan gloves, nothing worn on his back
characters.voice_phrase: a man with a deep, flat, unhurried voice

scenes.name: the dam-top walkway
scenes.description: a concrete walkway on top of a dam, steel railings on both sides, shipping containers and a small pump house at the far end, red rock canyon and blue reservoir behind, hard midday sun

scenes.name: the manager's office
scenes.description: a wood-panelled office: a large grey steel safe with a round dial in the left corner, a heavy desk with a brass lamp in the centre, a leather chesterfield sofa on the right, venetian-blind light stripes on the walls, the only door on the right wall

props.name: 红色稀有物品
props.description: REPLACE WITH A CATALOG ITEM: the exact red-tier item from the 三角洲 asset library, white-background reference

shots.framing: a wide shot down the length of the walkway
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {fengyi} walks toward the camera along the centre of the walkway, a combat knife held low in his right hand, his left hand resting on his headset; his expression is a confident half-smile, lips closed; he does not look at the camera

shots.framing: a medium shot at the steel door at the end of the walkway
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {fengyi} arrives at the grey steel door, pushes it open with his left shoulder, and steps through into the dark interior; the door swings half shut behind him

segments.soundscape: Wind across the dam top, boots on concrete, a distant spillway roar, the steel door's hinge creaking once as it opens.
segments.end_state: {fengyi} through the steel door, the walkway empty, the door half open
segments.negatives: Only one person is present; the knife stays in his right hand

shots.framing: a medium tracking shot in a dim corridor
shots.camera: The camera tracks left with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: {fengyi} moves along the left wall in a low crouch, knife low in his right hand, stops at an open office doorway and leans his head in to look

shots.framing: a medium shot inside the office, from the desk toward the safe
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the safe
shots.action: {fengyi} slips through the door, takes two steps, and stops one metre in front of the large grey safe in the left corner, facing it; his eyes widen and his mouth opens slightly

segments.soundscape: Fluorescent hum in the corridor, soft boot steps on carpet, a ventilation duct ticking, the whisper close to the mic.
segments.continuity: Same clothing, headset and knife as the previous segment; he has just entered the building.
segments.end_state: {fengyi} standing one metre in front of the closed safe, at frame left, facing it; the office door open behind him at frame right
segments.negatives: The office is empty apart from him; the safe is closed

shots.framing: a close-up on the safe dial and his hands
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {fengyi} crouches at the safe, his knife now sheathed, both gloved hands on the round dial, his right ear pressed against the steel door; the dial turns right, then left, then right

shots.framing: an over-the-shoulder shot from behind his right shoulder into the safe
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: the lock clunks, {fengyi} pulls the heavy door open; on the middle shelf, alone, sits {prop_red_loot}; he freezes with his right hand reaching toward it

segments.soundscape: The dial clicking tooth by tooth, his breathing, a heavy mechanical clunk as the bolts withdraw, the thick door groaning open.
segments.continuity: He is in front of the same safe at frame left; the office door is open at frame right; nobody else has entered.
segments.end_state: {fengyi} crouched at the open safe, right hand reaching toward {prop_red_loot} on the middle shelf, his back to the office door
segments.negatives: Only {prop_red_loot} is inside the safe; the item stays on the shelf untouched

shots.framing: a medium-wide shot from behind {fengyi} at the safe, the office door visible at frame right
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {fengyi} is crouched at the open safe at frame left, right hand still inside; the door at frame right swings open and {weilong} steps in and stops on the threshold, rifle lowered across his chest; {fengyi} freezes mid-reach and does not turn

shots.framing: a medium shot on {weilong} in the doorway
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {weilong} tilts his helmet slightly toward the safe and speaks once; {fengyi} is visible at the edge of frame, mouth closed, slowly turning his head toward the door

dialogue.speaker: weilong
dialogue.delivery: flat and calm, said only once

segments.soundscape: The door handle clicking, the door's slow creak, two heavy boot steps stopping on the threshold, then silence except the ventilation tick.
segments.music: A single low sustained synth note enters when the door opens and holds.
segments.continuity: {fengyi} is exactly where the previous segment left him: crouched at the open safe at frame left, hand toward {prop_red_loot}; {prop_red_loot} is still on the shelf; the office door is at frame right.
segments.end_state: {weilong} standing on the threshold at frame right, {fengyi} crouched at the safe at frame left looking back over his shoulder, {prop_red_loot} still on the shelf
segments.negatives: Exactly two people are present; {weilong} carries nothing on his back

shots.framing: a medium two-shot at the safe
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {weilong} walks three steps from the door to the safe, reaches past {fengyi}'s shoulder, lifts {prop_red_loot} off the shelf and holds it up at chest height; {fengyi} stays crouched, his hand still hanging in the air where the item was

shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: his eyes move from the empty shelf up to {weilong}, his jaw drops

segments.soundscape: Three boot steps on carpet, a small metallic scrape as the item leaves the shelf, a sharp intake of breath.
segments.music: The sustained synth note cuts off on the yelp.
segments.continuity: Positions exactly as the previous segment ended: {weilong} at the door frame right, {fengyi} crouched at the safe frame left, {prop_red_loot} on the middle shelf.
segments.end_state: a hard hold on {fengyi}'s stunned face
segments.negatives: Exactly two people; the item leaves the safe only in {weilong}'s hand
